title: Weekly Model Recap: 27 Frontier & Open-Weight Releases (2026-07-25)
author: Modelverse Editorial Team
excerpt: Complete weekly digest of 27 newly released AI models featuring specs, parent companies, primary tasks, and key features.
body:
Welcome to the **Modelverse Weekly Digest** for 2026-07-25.

This week, our automated ingestion engine indexed and published **27 frontier and open-weight AI models**.

### Featured Releases This Week

#### 🚀 [Motion4Motion](https://www.themodelverse.in/models/motion4motion)
- **Parent Company / Developer**: Tsinghua University & StepFun
- **Primary Task / Use Case**: video-generation
- **Modalities**: video
- **Parameters**: undisclosed
- **Key Highlights**: Training-Free: No fine-tuning or task-specific training required — runs at inference time on any video pair. Skeleton-Free Motion Transfer: Models subject motion flow instead of skeleton topology, enabling transfer across different species and body types
- **Links**: [View Specs & Benchmarks on Modelverse](https://www.themodelverse.in/models/motion4motion)
